reference: só gʷr̥Húm wóǵʰom weǵʰed; só méǵh₂m̥ bʰórom; só dʰǵʰémonm̥ h₂ṓḱu bʰered. h₂ówis h₁ékʷoybʰyos wewked: "dʰǵʰémonm̥ spéḱyoh₂ h₁éḱwoms-kʷe h₂áǵeti, ḱḗr moy agʰnutor". h₁éḱwōs tu wewkond: "ḱludʰí, h₂owey! tód spéḱyomes, n̥sméy agʰnutór ḱḗr: dʰǵʰémō, pótis, sē h₂áwyes h₂wl̥h₁náh₂ gʷʰérmom wéstrom wept, h₂áwibʰyos tu h₂wl̥h₁náh₂ né h₁esti. tód ḱeḱluwṓs h₂ówis h₂aǵróm bʰuged.

h₂ówis tu h₁eḱwoibʰ(y)os weukʷét, "ḱḗr Hegʰnutór moi h₁éḱwons Héǵontm̥ Hnérm̥ widn̥tbʰ(y)os." h₁éḱwōs tu weukʷónt, "ḱludʰí, h₂ówei, ḱḗr gʰe Hegʰnutór n̥sméi widn̥tbʰ(y)ós. Hnḗr, pótis, h₂éwyom r̥ wl̥h₂néHm sebʰi kʷr̥néuti nu gʷʰérmom wéstrom néǵʰi h₂éwyom wl̥h₂néH h₁ésti." tód ḱeḱluwṓs h₂ówis Héǵrom bʰugét.

owis eḱwobʰyos eweket, "ḱerd angʰetai moi widontei ǵʰm̥onm̥ eḱwons aǵontm̥." eḱwos wewekur, "ḱludʰe, owei! ḱerd angʰetai widontbʰyos: ǵʰm̥on, potis, wl̥nam owiyōm kʷr̥neti soi gʷʰermom westrom; owibʰyos kʷe wl̥nā ne esti". tod ḱeḱlōts owis aǵrom ebʰuget.

úpo h₃rḗḱs deywóm wérunom sesole nú deywóm h₁yaǵeto. "ḱludʰí moi, pter werune!" deywós wérunos diwés km̥tá gʷah₂t. "kʷíd wēlh₁si?" "súHnum wēlh₁mi." "tód h₁estu", wéwked lewkós deywós wérunos. nu h₃réḱs pótnih₂ súHnum ǵeǵonh₁e.

owis nu eḱwobʰ(y)os (eḱwomos) ewewkʷet, "ḱēr agʰnutoi moi eḱwōns aǵontm̥ nerm̥ widn̥tei". eḱwōs tu ewewkʷont, "ḱludʰi, owei, ḱēr gʰe agʰnutoi n̥smei widn̥tbʰ(y)os (widn̥tmos): nēr, potis, owiōm r̥ wl̥Hnām sebʰi gʷʰermom westrom kʷrn̥euti. neǵʰi owiōm wl̥Hnā esti." tod ḱeḱluwōs owis aǵrom ebʰuget.
so rḗḱs súHnum éwel(e)t. "kʷíd welsi?" "wélmi súHnum." "tód h₁éstu", wéukʷet loukós deiwos werunos.

owis eḱwobʰos eweukʷet, "ḱerd agʰnutai moi widn̥tei ǵʰm̥onm̥ eḱwons aǵontm̥". eḱwoi eweukʷont, "ḱludʰi, owi, ḱerd agʰnutai dedr̥ḱusbʰos: monus potis wl̥nām owiōm temneti: sebʰei gʷʰermom westrom, owibʰos kʷe wl̥nā ne esti." tod ḱeḱluwōs owis aǵrom ebʰuget.

h₂ówis (h₁)éḱwobʰos ewewkʷe(t), "ḱḗrd h₂gʰnutoy moy widntéy dʰǵʰmónm (h₁)éḱwons h₂éǵontm." (h₁)éḱwōs ewewkʷ, "ḱludʰí, h₂ówi! ḱḗrd h₂gʰnutoy widntbʰós: dʰǵʰémō(n), pótis, h₂wlnéh₂m h₂ówyom kʷnewti sébʰoy gʷʰérmom wéstrom; h₂éwibʰoskʷe h₂wlh₂néh₂ né h₁esti." tód ḱeḱluwṓs h₂ówis h₂éǵrom ebʰuge(t).

kʷéh₂m pékʷōh₂?

só gʷowsth₂óy h₁ésti.

tód wérǵm̥. widé tód.

kʷíd wósn̥ h₁ésti?

kʷíd stóloy h₁ésti?

tóh₁ kʷíh₁ h₂éǵoh₂?
English: How do I drive them?

tód dʰǵʰémi Hn̥dʰí h₁éyti.
English: It goes under the earth.

tód ḱlutóm h₁nómn̥ h₁ésti.
English: It is a famous name.

h₃rēǵés dʰéh₁mn̥ yéh₂mi.
